I added a one-line docstring to both functions in `src/flags.py`:

- `is_on(name)`: "Return whether the named flag is on; flags missing from flags.toml read as False."
- `all_flags()`: "Return a copy of every flag declared in flags.toml, mapped to its value."

The `is_on` docstring mentions the missing-flag behaviour because a project note warns that an undeclared flag silently returns False. Nothing else changed, and I didn't commit.
